summary: Completed Module 02 BUILD: Diagnosed and resolved Bug #3 (Log Level Override) and Bug #4 (Timestamp Timezone Mismatch)
evidence: Diagnosed Bug #3: Hardcoded WARN log level override in apps/api/app/core/logging.py silenced request lifecycle logs; fixed by dynamically loading LOG_LEVEL from environment with default INFO
Verified Bug #3 fix: Sent requests to /health, /r/test01, and /r/unknown99, confirming structured INFO logs with correlation request IDs and latency metrics are emitted
Diagnosed Bug #4: Query filter in links_service.py compared UTC created_at against naive local datetime.now(), causing midnight 404s for servers located behind UTC
Fixed Bug #4: Enforced universal UTC timezone-aware comparisons using datetime.now(timezone.utc)
Verified Bug #4 fix: Links created at UTC midnight boundary resolve immediately without timezone lag
Maintained progress/module-02-diagnosis.md with all hypotheses, observations, and verification proofs
